summary: A Flathead National Forest fire tower with a 1916 log cabin, a 1960s helicopter-built replacement, and a 2015 Bear Creek fire evacuation; staffed each summer.

facts.design: 20-ft treated timber R-6 tower; earlier two-story 13x13 ft log cabin (1916)

access.note: Active Forest Service tower, staffed in summer. Sources do not say whether visitors may climb the tower.

visit.trail_note: Older Forest Service station description quoted on a lookout-history site: about 8 miles southeast from the Spotted Bear Ranger Station, mostly uphill. Verify the current route.

events.note: Forest History Society timeline: lookout constructed on Spotted Bear Mountain. Not corroborated by the register or firelookout.com.
First lookout established with a 2-story 13x13 log cabin (register and firelookout.com)
Forest History Society timeline says the 1914 lookout was replaced in 1933. Not corroborated by the other sources.
July 1936 smoke from the station turned out to be no fire; a lookout was posted there
October 1961 helicopter lift of a dismantled tower and cabin to replace a tower rated unsafe (newspaper)
Present 20-ft R-6 tower built, per the register and firelookout.com. A January 1962 newspaper item reports the helicopter material lift for it in October 1961.
Bear Creek fire: lookout wrapped in fire-resistant material on August 26; staff evacuated by helicopter on August 27

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources differ on the first lookout date (1914 in the Forest History Society timeline; 1916 in the register and firelookout.com) and are not reconciled here. The present tower is 1963 in the register and firelookout.com; a 1961 to 1962 helicopter lift of its parts is reported in newspapers.

sources.title: Spotted Bear Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Three build dates for the tower do not agree: 1914 (Forest History Society), 1916 (register and firelookout.com) for the first cabin, and 1963 (register and firelookout.com) for the present tower; newspapers put the helicopter lift in October 1961 and report it on 3 January 1962. The 1959 item mentions a 50-foot tower, which conflicts with the 20-foot tower in the 1961 item. The newspaper and station items on the montanalookouts page are quoted from old papers and an older station description that I did not check against the originals. Staffing 'seasonal' as of 2021 is from the register. No rental listing turned up in searches, and the 2024 Flathead cabin rental sheet has no entry for this tower (a negative check, not quoted). Lookout personnel named in the sources are not named here. The record's 1963 build year is not wrong per the register, but the 1916 first lookout and 1914 and 1933 dates are missing from the record's events. 2026-10-08 check: the newspaper dates and quotes were confirmed on the montanalookouts page; the original newspapers were not seen. The phrase 'still standing' was removed because no source says it.
